strings.meta.title: pdff — Whakakotahi, huri me te whakatika PDF, Word, Excel mō te kore utu
strings.meta.description: He taputapu tuihono kore utu hei whakakotahi, huri, kōpeke, wehe me te tiaki i ō kōnae PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, me ngā atahanga. Kāore he rīhitatanga, ka mukua tonutia ngā kōnae.
strings.meta.keywords: whakakotahi pdf, huri pdf, pdf ki word, word ki pdf, jpg ki pdf, pdf ki jpg, kōpeke pdf, wehe pdf, excel ki pdf, taputapu pdf kore utu
strings.footer.text: He kore utu, kāore he rīhitatanga. Ka mukua ō kōnae ina oti te tukatuka.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% kore utu
strings.seo.why[0].text: Kāore he ohaurunga, kāore he kāri nama, kāore he waitohu wai i tāpirihia ki ō tuhinga.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Kāore he rīhitatanga
strings.seo.why[1].text: Kāore he pūkete hei hanga: whakatuwheratia te whārangi, takaia ō kōnae, kua oti.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Ko ōu kōnae mōu anō
strings.seo.why[2].text: Kua tukatukaina, kātahi ka mukua tonutia. Kāore mātou e pupuri i ō tuhinga, i ō raraunga rānei.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Ngā hōputu katoa
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, atahanga, EPUB… mai i te rorohiko, waea pūkoro rānei.
strings.seo.faq[0].q: He tino kore utu rānei a pdff?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Āe. He kore utu ngā taputapu katoa, kāore he waitohu wai, kāore hoki he mea i mau ki muri i te ohaurunga. Kāore rawa e pātai mō tētahi kāri nama.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: Kāore. Kāore he rīhitatanga, kāore he wāhitau īmēra: ka whakamahi tonu koe i ngā taputapu.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: Kāore. Ka whakamahia anō ō kōnae mō te mahi i tonoa e koe, kātahi ka mukua. Kāore tētahi e pānui ana, ā, kāore e tohaina.
strings.seo.faq[3].q: He mahi rānei ki te waea?
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Āe. Kei roto a pdff i te pūtirotiro o tētahi noa iho waea, papa pāwhiri, rorohiko rānei (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), kāore he mea hei tāuta.
strings.seo.faq[4].q: Ko tēhea ngā hōputu e tautokona ana?
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, atahanga (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML me ētahi atu.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Ka taea e koe te tukatuka ki te {files} kōnae i te wā kotahi, ā, ko tētahi tuhinga ka puta ka eke pea ki te {pages} whārangi.
strings.privacy.title: Tūmataitinga
strings.privacy.description: Te whakahaere a pdff i ōu kōnae: kāore he pūkete, kāore he tuhinga i puritia, kāore he pānui, kāore hoki he hokonga raraunga.
strings.privacy.intro: I hangaia a pdff kia noho tonu ai ōu tuhinga māu. Anei, mā ngā kupu mārama, te mea ka tupu ina whakamahia.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Ō kōnae
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ka tukuna mai i raro i te whakamunatanga (HTTPS), ka tukatukaina ā-aunoa, kātahi ka mukua ina rite te hua. Ka haere ngā kōnae nunui mā roto i te wāhi pupuri rangirua i raro i te ingoa matapōkere, ka mukua hoki ina oti te tukatuka; mā tētahi horoinga aunoa e tango ngā mea katoa i roto i te 24 hora te roa rawa.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Kāore he pūkete, kāore he raraunga whaiaro
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: Kāore a pdff e tono rīhitatanga, wāhitau īmēra, kāri nama rānei. Kāore rawa ō tuhinga e pānuitia, e tātarihia, e tohaina, e whakamahia rānei hei whakangungu i te mātauranga horihori.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Inenga hunga mātakitaki
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Ka tatau mātou i ngā toro ā-ingoamuna me te kore pihikete (Vercel Web Analytics) ki te kimi ko tēhea ngā taputapu e whai hua ana. Kāore he pānui, kāore he whai wāhi whakawhiti paetukutuku.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Pihikete
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: He pihikete kotahi, he kōwhiringa anō: ka maumahara ki te reo i kōwhiria e koe.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Manaaki tūmau
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Kei a Vercel i Paris te paetukutuku; ko ngā hurihanga Word, Excel me PowerPoint ka whakahaeretia e Render i Frankfurt. Mā ēnei kaiwhakarato e whakahaere ngā kōnae i te wā o te hurihanga anake.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Whakapā
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: He pātai, he kōrero rānei? Whakapā mai i te whārangi kaupapa:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Whakakotahi
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Whakakotahitia ētahi kōnae (PDF, Word, atahanga…) ki tētahi PDF kotahi, i te raupapa i kōwhiria e koe.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Whakakotahi kōnae PDF tuihono mō te kore utu (Word, atahanga, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Whakakotahitia ngā kōnae PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint me ngā atahanga ki tētahi PDF kotahi, i te raupapa e hiahiatia ana. He kore utu, kāore he rīhitatanga, kāore he waitohu wai, ka mukua tonutia ngā kōnae.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Whakauruhia ō pepa katoa ki tētahi kōnae kotahi: ka tango a pdff i ngā PDF me ngā tuhinga Word, pepa Excel, whakaaturanga me ngā whakaahua, ā, ka whakakotahi ki tētahi PDF mārama me te Tohuwhārangi mō ia kōnae.

strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Huri PDF ki Word, Word ki PDF, JPG ki PDF — kore utu
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Kaitahuri kore utu: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB me ngā hōputu 40+. Tuihono, kāore he rīhitatanga, he kounga teitei.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: He kaitahuri mō ia hōputu: Word ki PDF, PDF ki Word, JPG ki PDF, PDF ki JPG, Excel ki PDF, PowerPoint ki PDF, PNG ki JPG, EPUB ki PDF… Takaia ō kōnae, ā, ka tukuna e pdff ngā hōputu e taea ana anake.

strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Wehea tētahi PDF ki ngā kōnae maha: mā ngā awhe whārangi, whārangi rānei ki te whārangi.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Wehe PDF tuihono mō te kore utu — whārangi wehe
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Wehea tētahi PDF ki ngā kōnae maha: mā ngā awhe whārangi, whārangi ki te whārangi, ia N whārangi rānei. He kore utu, he tere, kāore he rīhitatanga.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Tukua atu te wāhanga nui o tētahi tuhinga whakahirahira anake: ka tapahia e pdff tō PDF i ngā awhe i kōwhiria e koe, ā, ka whakahokia ngā wāhanga i roto i tētahi pūkete ZIP.

strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Pupuri, tango rānei i ētahi whārangi o tētahi PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Tangohia, mukua rānei ngā whārangi mai i te PDF — kore utu
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Puritia ngā whārangi e hiahiatia ana mai i tētahi PDF, mukua rānei ngā mea tāpiri. Tuihono, kore utu, kāore he rīhitatanga, kāore he waitohu wai.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: He whārangi wtea, he taapiri kore take, he tārua rānei? Patohia ngā whārangi hei pupuri, hei muku rānei (hei tauira 1-3, 7, 10-end) ka whiwhi i tētahi PDF mārama i roto i ngā hēkona.

strings.tools.extraire.options.pages.help: Hei tauira 1-3, 5, 8-end. Waiho kia wtea = ngā whārangi katoa.

strings.tools.organiser.tagline: Hurihia te raupapa whārangi, tārua, huripoki.
strings.tools.organiser.seoTitle: Whakarite anō ngā whārangi PDF tuihono — kore utu
strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Hurihia te raupapa o ngā whārangi o tētahi PDF, tāruatia ētahi, huripokina rānei te tuhinga katoa. He kore utu, tuihono, kāore he rīhitatanga.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: I matawaihia ngā whārangi i waho i te raupapa? Patohia te raupapa hou (hei tauira 3, 1, 2, 4-end) huripokina rānei te tuhinga katoa: mā pdff e mahi te toenga.

strings.tools.organiser.options.order.help: Ka mukua ngā whārangi kāore i te rārangi.

strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Whakaparahatia ngā whārangi katoa o tētahi PDF, ētahi rānei, mā te 90°, 180°, 270° rānei. He kore utu, he tere, kāore he rīhitatanga.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: He matawai tahuri-turi, he whārangi whenua rānei? Whakaparahatia te tuhinga katoa, ngā whārangi i tīpakohia rānei, me te kore ngaro o te kounga.

strings.tools.numeroter.seoDescription: Tāpirihia ngā tau whārangi ki tētahi PDF: tīpakohia te tūnga, te hōputu "1 / 10", te tau tuatahi me te rahi. He kore utu, kāore he rīhitatanga.
strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Tika rawa mō tētahi tuhinga paetahi, kōnae tono, pūrongo rānei: tīpakohia te tūnga, hōputu me te tau tuatahi, ā, ka tauwhārangitia e pdff ō whārangi kia mārama.

strings.tools.filigrane.seoDescription: Tāia he waitohu wai kupu (TŪMATANUI KORE, TĀRUA, TAHORA…) ki tētahi PDF me te rahi e taea ana te panoni, te mānakonako, te koki me te tae. He kore utu.

strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Whakaitihia tētahi PDF hei tuku mā te īmēra, hei tukuake rānei ki tētahi paetukutuku whaimana. E toru ngā taumata kōpeketanga, he kore utu.

strings.tools.proteger.intro: I mua i te tuku utunga, tuhinga hauora rānei, maukati ki te kupuhipa kaha: ki te kore, kāore tētahi e taea te whakatuwhera.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: E mōhio ana koe ki te kupuhipa, engari he pōuritanga te pato i ia wā? Tangohia kia kotahi te wā. Kāore rawa a pdff e karo i tētahi kupuhipa kāore koe e mōhio.
